text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming p99 latency breach detected for route /v1/stream (model=text-stream-prod, region=us-west-2). p99 > 3.2s, p95 ~ 750ms. Auto-page to oncall (severity=P2).

maria.g: I'm on the page, joining. seeing large tail on streaming responses, some clients report stalls.

ajay: Looking at metrics — sudden spike in CPU wait + GPU kernel retries for pool gpu-pool-7. p50 fine, p95 elevated, p99 huge tail.

infra-lead: Telemetry: node gpu-24 showing rising correctable ECCs, temperature 87-89C, fan at 93%. Could be thermal throttle causing kernel retries.

maria.g: Can we start live mitigation? Suggest draining traffic off gpu-24 and routing to fallback pool. dave, can we apply route override?

dave: On it. Will switch ~10% at a time to avoid cold-cache regressions. Applying fallback route to quantized-variant.

oncall: FYI customer impact: ~6% of streaming sessions in us-west-2 affected; one support ticket from AcmeCorp reporting repeated stalls. No PG-wide errors, only degraded tail latency.

sre-bot: Auto-run diagnostics kicked off: diag-id=diag-1765439999-1.

maria.g: Running quick checks — attaching commands:
```
# quick node probe
ssh root@node-gpu-24
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,temperature.gpu,fan.speed,utilization.gpu,correctable_errors --format=csv
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 200 | grep "kv-span|stream" | tail -n 50
```

ajay: Paste from nvidia-smi: 
```
index, name, temperature.gpu, fan.speed, utilization.gpu, correctable_errors
0, A6000, 88, 93 %, 64 %, 120 correctables
```

maria.g: 120 correctables is high and climbing. Also seeing repeated "kv cache miss -> refill -> stall" log snippet.

infra-lead: Thermal profile indicates this rack's cooling loop had a transient setpoint drift ~15:12 UTC, fan controllers jumped. Ops to facility alerted. Could be correlated but node also shows flaky ECC.

dave: Traffic reroute in progress: `routectl set-weight --pool gpu-pool-7 --weight 0.75` then decrement node weight for node-gpu-24. Staged.

maria.g: Draining command executed for node-gpu-24: `redwood node drain node-gpu-24 --grace 30s`. Monitoring p99 now.

oncall: Initial mitigation effect: p99 dropped from 3.2s to ~1.1s within 90s after staged reroute. Some sessions still show stalls (likely in-flight kv state).

ajay: Captured streaming stall trace for one request: "gpu kernel requeue -> page fault -> kernel retry" repeated 3x before completion. Suggest isolating node for deeper triage.

infra-lead: Agree. Recommend quarantining node-gpu-24 (take offline for ECC scrub / priority firmware check). Create maintenance ticket.

maria.g: Creating maintenance: MT-1765439999, marking node as quarantined and shifting traffic.

oncall: Handoff request — handing to infra-lead for hardware evaulation. I'll monitor customer impact and coordinate comms with support. @dave continue watch on routing for 30m.

infra-lead: Acknowledged. Will escalate to hardware vendor if ECC continues after scrub. Collecting logs + nvml dump.

sre-bot: Action items: [1] Quarantine node-gpu-24 (infra) [2] Run ECC scrub and nvml dump (infra) [3] Maintain route fallback for 30m (dave) [4] Customer comms draft (oncall) [5] Monitor p95/p99 in us-west-2 for 60m (maria.g).

maria.g: Quick customer impact note for ops: ~6% of live streaming sessions experienced >2s stalls, ~0.4% timed out and retried. Default retries handled most cases. We'll prepare post-incident notes after hardware triage.

dave: Routing hold: fallback remains in place, incremental traffic restored to pool once node cleared. Ping me if any cache-regression after full failover.

infra-lead: NVML dump attached to MT-1765439999. Observed correctable error counts bumping beyond threshold and persistent after soft-reset. Vendor contacted. ETA for vendor triage ~2-3h.

oncall: Escalation level set to SEV2 -> vendor oncall involved. If we see reoccurrence after drain, we'll elevate.

maria.g: For the postmortem we'll include timelines, thermal telemetry, ECC counts, and routing decision timeline. For now mitigation worked — p99 back to target but keep eyes on 30m window.

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial; monitoring. Next update in 15m or on any regression. :white_check_mark:
